Summarize governed stream synchronization

Source: R/sync-diagnostics.R
syncDiagnostics.Rd

Returns stored diagnostics for a synchronized container. For an unsynchronized container, models or shared events are evaluated through syncStreams() on a copy and only the diagnostics table is returned.

Usage

syncDiagnostics(x, models = NULL, shared_events = NULL)

Arguments

x

A PhysioExperiment::MultiPhysioExperiment.

models

Optional uniquely named StreamClockModel list.

shared_events

Optional exact event_id, stream, timestamp table.

Value

One plain data-frame row per stream/reset segment.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Requires a multi-stream container (MultiPhysioExperiment), e.g. from
# readXDF().
diagnostics <- syncDiagnostics(container)
} # }
